style: width: 100%; height: 100%; background: var(--navy-900); --plyr-color-main: var(--accent); --plyr-video-control-background-hover: rgba(20, 184, 166, 0.2); --plyr-control-radius: 12px; --plyr-range-track-height: 5px; --plyr-video-control-color: var(--color-white); &:hover .plyr__poster { transform: scale(1.05); }

children.style: position: relative; border-radius: 20px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); background: var(--slate-900);

width: 100%; display: block; .plyr__control--overlaid { background: rgba(20, 184, 166, 0.7); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px); padding: 30px; transition: all 0.3s ease; &:hover { background: var(--accent); transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.1); } svg { width: 40px; height: 40px; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)); } } .plyr__poster { background-size: cover; transition: transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.165, 0.84, 0.44, 1); }
